ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the middle of the attached figure is a square, and a regular octagon is attached to the outside of each of the four sides of the square. Near each square vertex, one interior angle of the square and the interior angles of the two adjacent regular octagons exactly surround a full turn, with no gaps and no overlap. Reasoning: Extend this local vertex condition to the general case: when a regular m-gon is surrounded by m regular n-gons, at each vertex of the central regular m-gon, exactly 1 interior angle of the regular m-gon and 2 interior angles of regular n-gons add up to 360 degrees. The interior angle of a regular k-gon is 180(k-2)/k degrees, so 180(m-2)/m + 2·180(n-2)/n = 360. Substituting m=10 gives 180·8/10 + 360(n-2)/n = 360. This is equivalent to 8/10 + 2(n-2)/n = 2, so 2(n-2)/n = 6/5, and further (n-2)/n = 3/5. Solving gives 5n - 10 = 3n, therefore 2n = 10, n = 5.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the central square has an octagon attached to each side, and near each square corner the two adjacent octagons share a slanted edge, so the side directions line up exactly. Model the same edge-direction condition for a regular m-gon surrounded by regular n-gons. At a vertex of the central m-gon, the direction changes by the exterior angle 360/m. Each attached n-gon contributes an exterior turn of 360/n from the central side to the shared side between neighboring outer polygons. Exact matching of the two adjacent outer polygons requires the two n-gon exterior turns plus the central m-gon exterior turn to form a straight angle: 2(360/n) + 360/m = 180. Substitute m = 10 and solve for n.

推理：把同样的边方向匹配条件推广到中心正 m 边形被 m 个正 n 边形围住的情形。在中心正 m 边形的一个顶点处，中心多边形的外角是 360/m。每个相邻的正 n 边形从与中心边重合的边转到两个外侧多边形之间的公共边，会贡献一个外角 360/n。为了让相邻两个外侧正 n 边形在该处恰好拼合，这两个 n 边形的外角加上中心正 m 边形的外角应形成平角：2(360/n) + 360/m = 180。代入 m=10，得 720/n + 36 = 180，所以 720/n = 144，n = 5。
